svg.text: SINGLE-LINE DIAGRAM – 185.4 kWp ROOFTOP SOLAR PV SYSTEM (GRID-TIED, ZERO EXPORT, NO BATTERY)
Kampala Marriott Hotel – mezzanine roof · 299 × 620 Wp modules · 2 × 80 kW string inverters
PV cable 6 mm² double-insulated, in UV-resistant trunking

RS485 / Modbus – active power limit to INV-01 / INV-02
Array frames & rails bonded (6/16 mm² Cu) → main earth bar → building earth
Integrated with existing lightning protection system (IEC 62305); SPDs on DC and AC sides
Strings: INV-01 8 × 19 · INV-02 3 × 19 + 5 × 18 · DC/AC 1.16 · Indicative – confirm with final equipment datasheets
IEC 62548 string current; 1,500 V DC solar cable
Ib ≤ In ≤ Iz: 115.5 ≤ 125 ≤ 168 A (hot roof, 2 circuits grouped)
Ib ≤ In ≤ Iz: 231 ≤ 250 ≤ 330 A; total AC drop 2.3 % (< 3 %); armoured for riser route
IEC 60364-5-54: line > 35 mm² → PE ≥ S/2 = 25 mm²
IEC 60364-5-54: 120 / 2 = 60 → next size 70 mm²; armour earthed both ends
* Typical IEC 60364-5-52 ratings (XLPE, Cu, on perforated tray / in air) derated for 45 °C roof ambient and grouping. Confirm against the cable manufacturer's data and the final route.
